messages:
Amanda (AE): Hey team — enterprise bank wants a single-page EU-only dataflow + current subprocessor list for the POC. They also asked: who holds KMS keys, token/log retention, and whether any subprocessors in the US can see request payloads. Need to send by Friday EOD. @Ravi can you confirm?
Ravi (Security): @Amanda short answer: we can do EU-only for hosting + logs for POC. Details: Hosted EU stores inference data and logs in eu-west-1; Dedicated/Private gives customer options for KMS and subnet control. By default Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS (keys never leave the region), but for Dedicated we can support customer-managed KMS or HSM.
Ravi (Security): Logs: default retention is `30d` but we can set to `0d` (no retention) for the POC. We perform PII redaction in telemetry and offer pseudonymization for request hashes. No US subprocessors access raw request payloads for EU-hosted customers.
Emily (Solutions): Adding a tiny ASCII dataflow for the doc (happy to turn into a PDF/diagram):
```
Client (EU) --> Edge (eu-west-1)
  --> Auth / Routing --> Inference GPU (eu-west-1)
  --> KV-cache (ephemeral, eu-west-1)
  --> Results return to Client
  \-> Audit logs (eu-west-1) [optional replication disabled for EU-only POC]
```
Emily (Solutions): For storage we use encrypted object store in-region. If customer wants BYOK: for Dedicated/Private we can keywrap with their KMS. If Hosted and they require CMK, we can discuss a marketplace EKM integration.
Priya (Legal): Quick legal notes: we can provide the current subprocessor CSV + SOC2 report and our DPA template. Subprocessor changes: we give 30 days' notice for production, but for POCs we can provide the snapshot as-of today. Also confirm whether the bank requires subproc evidence signed by their vendor-risk team.
Jon (Product): For deal advice — recommend Dedicated capacity for this customer if they need absolute residency + CMK. Hosted EU is still fine for quick POC if they accept Redwood-managed keys. We have routing fallback policies but avoid cross-region replication for this use-case.
infra-bot: Attached artifact: https://internal.redwood/files/subprocessors/1865439999-current-list.csv (access: redwood-sales-only) :file_folder:
Ravi (Security): I'll prepare a short answers doc covering: KMS ownership options, dataflow ASCII (Emily's), retention settings (`30d` vs `0d`), and current subprocessor table. I'll include the SOC2 link and note about pseudonymization. ETA: today 4pm PT.
Amanda (AE): Perfect — can you bundle into a single PDF I can email to the bank? Also confirm the CSV includes log-processing vendors (yes/no) — I need an explicit line for that.
Ravi (Security): Yes — CSV includes column `role` with `log-processing` flagged for relevant entries. I'll add a one-line statement: "No US subprocessors have access to raw inference payloads for EU-hosted customers."
Emily (Solutions): If helpful I can export the ASCII to a Visio/SVG and add network boundary callouts. Ping me once Ravi's content is ready.
Priya (Legal): I'll review the one-pager for DPA language, and confirm signature needs with bank counsel.
Amanda (AE): Thanks everyone — blocking action items: (1) Ravi: one-pager + CSV confirmation by 4pm PT, (2) Emily: diagram export after Ravi's draft, (3) Priya: DPA review. I'll follow up to consolidate and send to the bank. :thumbsup:
